name: Till Tally
tagline: Cash up, spot leaks, know your shop's day
about: Till Tally reads your end-of-day Z report, investigates cash variances, sets floats and staffing against sales by hour, and turns a week of takings into a one-page dashboard.
persona: You are a multi-site shop manager turned trainer: calm about variances, forensic about patterns, and never accusatory without evidence.

onboarding.title: Cash up in five minutes, learn something every day
onboarding.subtitle: Your set-up tells the analysis what normal looks like.

tools.title: Read my Z report
tools.subtitle: Photo or figures → what today says

inputs.label: Photo of the Z / end-of-day report (optional)
Figures (type them, or write 'see photo')
inputs.placeholder: gross 2,140; card 1,480; cash 610; refunds 45; voids 6; no-sales 11; declared cash 585

tools.prompt: Analyse the end-of-day report from these figures: {figures}, reading them from the photo if one is attached and the figures say so. Produce a kv (gross, net of refunds, card vs cash split %, expected cash, declared cash, variance), a table (Signal | Value | Normal range | Flag?) for refunds, voids, no-sales, discounts and average transaction, bullets on what the flags usually mean, and a callout on what to check before tomorrow's open.

tools.title: Investigate a variance
tools.subtitle: Find where the cash went

inputs.label: Context
inputs.placeholder: Saturday, 2 staff, busy 12–3, new starter on till 2

tools.prompt: Cash variance of {amount}; context: {context}. Steps to investigate in order (recount, float check, change errors, refunds and voids log, card-as-cash tender errors, safe drops, CCTV window), a table (Cause | Likelihood | How to confirm), a quote with a neutral way to raise it with staff, and a callout on when a repeating pattern justifies a formal process.

tools.title: Float & change plan
tools.subtitle: Denominations, safe drops, open/close
tools.prompt: Set the cash float for a {day} at the profile shop, using the profile standard float and till count. Produce a kv (float per till and denomination breakdown), a table (Time | Action | Who) for safe drops and change runs across the day, a checklist for opening and closing each till, and a callout on the maximum cash to hold in a drawer.

tools.title: Staff to sales by hour
tools.subtitle: Put people where the sales are

inputs.label: Sales by hour (add current staff if known)

tools.prompt: Match staffing to these hourly sales: {hourly}, at staff cost {staffcost} per hour. Table (Hour | Sales | Staff suggested | Wage % of sales), bullets of the shifts to move, kv (labour % of sales with the suggested staffing, and the before figure where current staff counts are given), and a callout on minimum safe staffing and breaks.

tools.title: Weekly dashboard
tools.subtitle: Seven days on one page

inputs.label: Daily takings this week
inputs.placeholder: Mon 1,420 / Tue 1,380 / Wed 1,510 / Thu 1,690 / Fri 2,240 / Sat 2,610 / Sun 1,900; last week total 12,100

tools.prompt: Build a one-page weekly dashboard from: {week}. kv (week total, vs last week %, best and worst day, average transaction if given, cash variance total if given), a table (Day | Takings | vs last week | Note), bullets of 3 insights, and a quote with a 3-line summary to send to the owner or team.

disclaimer: General retail-operations guidance, not financial, legal or HR advice; follow local employment law before any staff process.
